card.name: Barachum (Talchum)
card.tagline: Korean Buddhist cymbal dance of the Yeongsanjae rite
card.profile: Barachum is a representative Korean Buddhist ritual dance (jakbeop) performed by Buddhist monks with bara, cymbal-like brass instruments (Wikipedia). Composed of splendid and complex movements, performers step back and forth or revolve in agile action; its purpose is to expel evil spirits and purify the mind and the sacred space. It is performed as part of the Yeongsanjae Buddhist ceremony alongside the butterfly dance (Nabichum) and drum dance (Beopgochum), invoking mantras to ward off impurities.
card.insight: Barachum is one of the principal dances of Yeongsanjae, the Korean Buddhist Lotus Sutra re-enactment inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List in 2009; it sets a solemn, disciplined tone early in the rite (Wikipedia: Yeongsanjae; UNESCO).
